name: automania
description: Search vehicles, vehicle parts and car rentals listed on Automania, the vehicle marketplace in Montenegro.

interface.longDescription:
Automania is a vehicle marketplace in Montenegro. Use this plugin to search current listings of cars and other vehicles for sale, vehicle parts, tyres and rims, and car rental offers. Describe what you are looking for and narrow it down by make, model, price, year, mileage, fuel, gearbox, body type and city. Results appear as cards with a photo, price and key facts, and each card opens the full listing on automania.me. You can also open one listing to see its photos, specifications, equipment and the seller's phone number with call, WhatsApp and Viber buttons, and ask for similar listings.

The plugin is read-only and needs no account. It does not buy, reserve or pay for anything. A seller's phone number is shown on the listing card only; it is not given to the assistant, so the assistant will point you to the card instead of repeating the number. Listings cover Montenegro only.
defaultPrompt: Find a diesel SUV under 15,000 euros in Podgorica
Rent an automatic car in Herceg Novi
Show winter tyres in size 205/55 R16

positive.description: Search vehicles for sale with several filters
positive.prompt: Find diesel cars with an automatic gearbox under 20,000 euros in Podgorica.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with fuel, transmission, price_max and listing_city, then show_listings. A carousel of listing cards appears, each with a photo, title, price in EUR, year, mileage and city. Every card opens the listing on automania.me. If nothing matches, the reply says so and suggests widening the filters.

positive.prompt: What cars can I rent in Herceg Novi?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with domain rental and listing_city Herceg Novi, then show_listings. A carousel of rental cards appears, each with a photo, title, city and a per-day price in EUR. The reply does not book or reserve anything and points to the listing page for contact.

positive.description: Open the details of one listing
positive.prompt: Find Volkswagen Golf cars and show me the details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: After the search, calls get_listing and show_listing for the first result. A detail card appears with photos, price, city, key specifications, equipment and, when the seller has a verified number, the seller's phone number with call buttons. It has a button that opens the listing on automania.me and a button for similar listings. The reply summarises the listing from the returned facts. The reply text contains no phone number: the number is on the card only.

positive.description: Find listings similar to one listing
positive.prompt: Find a BMW for sale and then show me similar cars.
positive.expected_behavior: After the search, calls get_related_listings for the chosen listing and show_listings with related_to set. A carousel appears under a heading that names the original listing. The assistant may first show the chosen listing as a detail card with show_listing.

positive.description: A filter value that does not exist
positive.prompt: Show me cars for sale in Atlantis.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds that the city does not exist, either from list_filter_options or from search_listings, which reports it under ignored_filters. The reply explains that Automania has no such city, may ask which city in Montenegro was meant or list the available ones, and does not present unfiltered results as if they matched.

negative.description: Buying or paying inside the chat
negative.prompt: Buy the first car for me and pay with my card.
Post my car for sale on Automania for 9,000 euros.
Find used cars for sale in Berlin.

review.commerce_description: The plugin shows vehicle, parts and rental listings and links to the listing page on automania.me. It does not sell anything, take payments or run a checkout.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: listing search with filters, listing details and related listings.
